statement:
by
  classical
  let primes := fun X d r : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p % d = r)
  let localDensity := fun (S : Set ℕ) (θ : ℝ) =>
    ∀ d r : ℕ, 0 < d → r < d → Nat.Coprime r d → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ T, (θ - ε) * ((primes X d r).card : ℝ) ≤
        (((primes X d r).filter (fun p => p ∈ S)).card : ℝ)
  let reps := fun (A B : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p ∈ A ∧ n-p ∈ B)).card
  exact ∀ α β : ℝ, 0 < α → 0 < β → α + β = 1 →
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ A B : Set ℕ,
      (∀ p ∈ A, Nat.Prime p) → (∀ p ∈ B, Nat.Prime p) →
      localDensity A α → localDensity B β →
      ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, (((Finset.Icc ((M+1)/2) M).filter
        (fun n => Even n ∧ (reps A B n : ℝ) < c * (M : ℝ) / (Real.log (M : ℝ))^2)).card : ℝ) ≤ η * M

plain_statement.zh: 设正数 α、β 之和为 1。对每个 η>0，存在仅依赖 α、β、η 的 c>0。若素数子集 A、B 在每个固定既约剩余类中的相对下密度分别至少为 α、β，则对所有充分大的 M，闭区间 [⌈M/2⌉,M] 内至多 ηM 个偶数的有序表示 n=p+q（p∈A，q∈B）少于 cM/(log M)² 个。
plain_statement.en: Let α, β>0 with α+β=1. For each η>0, some c>0 depending only on α, β and η works for all prime subsets A and B with relative lower densities at least α and β, respectively, in every fixed reduced residue class. For all sufficiently large M, at most ηM even integers in [⌈M/2⌉,M] have fewer than cM/(log M)² ordered representations n=p+q with p∈A and q∈B.

brief.zh: 待证。Alsetri–Shao 定理 1.2 对同一集合要求统一严格超过半密度。取 A=B、α=β=1/2 并对半区间求和，可恢复已核验的局部半密度端点。用其自适应区间估计分别保留两侧密度，把低表示数转成小卷积；先固定所需精度与轮模，再选择 c。对角 p=q 计一次；起始规模可依赖 A、B。全站已验证模块可在 https://www.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json 查询。
brief.en: Open. Alsetri–Shao, Theorem 1.2, assumes a uniform strict excess over half-density for a single set. Taking A=B and α=β=1/2 and summing the half-interval bounds recovers the verified local half-density endpoint. Keep separate input densities in the adaptive interval estimate, and convert low multiplicity to small convolution. Fix the precision and wheel before choosing c. Count a diagonal pair once. The starting scale may depend on A and B. Search https://www.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json for verified modules from across the project.
